q: The capacity of a multiple access channel (MAC) where users 1 and 2 share a channel to one receiver is:
opts: C = max I(X₁,X₂;Y) over independent inputs
A rate region: R₁≤I(X₁;Y|X₂), R₂≤I(X₂;Y|X₁), R₁+R₂≤I(X₁,X₂;Y)
exp: The MAC capacity region (Ahlswede 1971, Liao 1972) is a pentagon in rate space. Each user gets a rate up to the mutual information given the other user's signal, and their sum is bounded by joint mutual information.
